release_notes.headline_internal: Worktree deletion is now Git-authoritative, deadline-bounded, and quiescent before response
release_notes.headline_external: Advance v1.21.0 improves reliable and safe worktree cleanup
highlights: Deletion now uses expiring token-bound plans and drift revalidation.
Valid unregistered and patch-equivalent worktrees can be cleaned without manual Git fallback.
Target-project routing is bounded before heavy initialization.
Kernel-flock process leases and shared cancellation prevent mutation after timeout responses.
Delete, cleanup, archive, and pending-drain paths share one safety implementation.
